pr.title: gh-111178: fix UBSan failures in `Modules/_collectionsmodule.c`
pr.body:
This PR fixes the UBSan failures and addresses some minor cosmetic changes. PEP-7 changes were not applied since they could scramble the diff but other semantic changes affecting the signature of touched functions may have been done.

<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-111178 -->
* Issue: gh-111178
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->

auto_merge.commit_message:
Fix some UBSan failures for `dequeobject`, `dequeiterobject`, `defdictobject` and `tuplegetterobject`.

We also perform some cleanup by suppressing unused return values and renaming the
unused argument in `METH_NOARGS` methods to `dummy` for semantic purposes.

review_comments.body:
Nitpick: the `(PyObject *)` cast is not needed here (though of course does not hurt either).
However, it would be the only occurence in the entire code base where the argument of `Py_SIZE` is casted , now that you've removed the casts in
```c
    vs = Py_SIZE((dequeobject *)v);
    ws = Py_SIZE((dequeobject *)w);
``` 
in `deque_richcompare` above (which I very much appreciate btw :)
Oh good catch. Those changes are mechanical and sometimes this happens!

issue_comments.body: Ah I'm sorry I put this one as ready for review but I learned that _ + capital letter was also UB (https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/128248#issuecomment-2615838172). Even though `_` + lowercase letter is not UB (hopefully), this one can be reviewed. However, for consistency, I'll also remove the `_` tomorrow along with the other PRs.
